64// Additional flags and pointers that need to be stored with each message type
65struct ubxAutomaticFlags
66{
67 union
68 {
69 uint8_t all;
70 struct
71 {
72 uint8_t automatic : 1; // Will this message be delivered and parsed "automatically" (without polling)
73 uint8_t implicitUpdate : 1; // Is the update triggered by accessing stale data (=true) or by a call to checkUblox (=false)
74 uint8_t addToFileBuffer : 1; // Should the raw UBX data be added to the file buffer?
75 uint8_t callbackCopyValid : 1; // Is the copy of the data struct used by the callback valid/fresh?
76 } bits;
77 } flags;
78};

166// UBX-NAV-STATUS (0x01 0x03): Receiver navigation status
167const uint16_t UBX_NAV_STATUS_LEN = 16;
168
169typedef struct
170{
171 uint32_t iTOW; // GPS time of week of the navigation epoch: ms
172 uint8_t gpsFix; // GPSfix Type: 0x00 = no fix; 0x01 = dead reckoning only; 0x02 = 2D-fix; 0x03 = 3D-fix
173 // 0x04 = GPS + dead reckoning combined; 0x05 = Time only fix; 0x06..0xff = reserved
174 union
175 {
176 uint8_t all;
177 struct
178 {
179 uint8_t gpsFixOk : 1; // 1 = position and velocity valid and within DOP and ACC Masks.
180 uint8_t diffSoln : 1; // 1 = differential corrections were applied
181 uint8_t wknSet : 1; // 1 = Week Number valid (see Time Validity section for details)
182 uint8_t towSet : 1; // 1 = Time of Week valid (see Time Validity section for details)
183 } bits;
184 } flags;
185 union
186 {
187 uint8_t all;
188 struct
189 {
190 uint8_t diffCorr : 1; // 1 = differential corrections available
191 uint8_t carrSolnValid : 1; // 1 = valid carrSoln
192 uint8_t reserved : 4;
193 uint8_t mapMatching : 2; // map matching status: 00: none
194 // 01: valid but not used, i.e. map matching data was received, but was too old
195 // 10: valid and used, map matching data was applied
196 // 11: valid and used, map matching data was applied.
197 } bits;
198 } fixStat;
199 union
200 {
201 uint8_t all;
202 struct
203 {
204 uint8_t psmState : 2; // power save mode state
205 // 0: ACQUISITION [or when psm disabled]
206 // 1: TRACKING
207 // 2: POWER OPTIMIZED TRACKING
208 // 3: INACTIVE
209 uint8_t reserved1 : 1;
210 uint8_t spoofDetState : 2; // Spoofing detection state
211 // 0: Unknown or deactivated
212 // 1: No spoofing indicated
213 // 2: Spoofing indicated
214 // 3: Multiple spoofing indications
215 uint8_t reserved2 : 1;
216 uint8_t carrSoln : 2; // Carrier phase range solution status:
217 // 0: no carrier phase range solution
218 // 1: carrier phase range solution with floating ambiguities
219 // 2: carrier phase range solution with fixed ambiguities
220 } bits;
221 } flags2;
222 uint32_t ttff; // Time to first fix (millisecond time tag): ms
223 uint32_t msss; // Milliseconds since Startup / Reset: ms
224} UBX_NAV_STATUS_data_t;
225

360// UBX-NAV-PVT (0x01 0x07): Navigation position velocity time solution
361const uint16_t UBX_NAV_PVT_LEN = 92;
362
363typedef struct
364{
365 uint32_t iTOW; // GPS time of week of the navigation epoch: ms
366 uint16_t year; // Year (UTC)
367 uint8_t month; // Month, range 1..12 (UTC)
368 uint8_t day; // Day of month, range 1..31 (UTC)
369 uint8_t hour; // Hour of day, range 0..23 (UTC)
370 uint8_t min; // Minute of hour, range 0..59 (UTC)
371 uint8_t sec; // Seconds of minute, range 0..60 (UTC)
372 union
373 {
374 uint8_t all;
375 struct
376 {
377 uint8_t validDate : 1; // 1 = valid UTC Date
378 uint8_t validTime : 1; // 1 = valid UTC time of day
379 uint8_t fullyResolved : 1; // 1 = UTC time of day has been fully resolved (no seconds uncertainty).
380 uint8_t validMag : 1; // 1 = valid magnetic declination
381 } bits;
382 } valid;
383 uint32_t tAcc; // Time accuracy estimate (UTC): ns
384 int32_t nano; // Fraction of second, range -1e9 .. 1e9 (UTC): ns
385 uint8_t fixType; // GNSSfix Type:
386 // 0: no fix
387 // 1: dead reckoning only
388 // 2: 2D-fix
389 // 3: 3D-fix
390 // 4: GNSS + dead reckoning combined
391 // 5: time only fix
392 union
393 {
394 uint8_t all;
395 struct
396 {
397 uint8_t gnssFixOK : 1; // 1 = valid fix (i.e within DOP & accuracy masks)
398 uint8_t diffSoln : 1; // 1 = differential corrections were applied
399 uint8_t psmState : 3;
400 uint8_t headVehValid : 1; // 1 = heading of vehicle is valid, only set if the receiver is in sensor fusion mode
401 uint8_t carrSoln : 2; // Carrier phase range solution status:
402 // 0: no carrier phase range solution
403 // 1: carrier phase range solution with floating ambiguities
404 // 2: carrier phase range solution with fixed ambiguities
405 } bits;
406 } flags;
407 union
408 {
409 uint8_t all;
410 struct
411 {
412 uint8_t reserved : 5;
413 uint8_t confirmedAvai : 1; // 1 = information about UTC Date and Time of Day validity confirmation is available
414 uint8_t confirmedDate : 1; // 1 = UTC Date validity could be confirmed
415 uint8_t confirmedTime : 1; // 1 = UTC Time of Day could be confirmed
416 } bits;
417 } flags2;
418 uint8_t numSV; // Number of satellites used in Nav Solution
419 int32_t lon; // Longitude: deg * 1e-7
420 int32_t lat; // Latitude: deg * 1e-7
421 int32_t height; // Height above ellipsoid: mm
422 int32_t hMSL; // Height above mean sea level: mm
423 uint32_t hAcc; // Horizontal accuracy estimate: mm
424 uint32_t vAcc; // Vertical accuracy estimate: mm
425 int32_t velN; // NED north velocity: mm/s
426 int32_t velE; // NED east velocity: mm/s
427 int32_t velD; // NED down velocity: mm/s
428 int32_t gSpeed; // Ground Speed (2-D): mm/s
429 int32_t headMot; // Heading of motion (2-D): deg * 1e-5
430 uint32_t sAcc; // Speed accuracy estimate: mm/s
431 uint32_t headAcc; // Heading accuracy estimate (both motion and vehicle): deg * 1e-5
432 uint16_t pDOP; // Position DOP * 0.01
433 union
434 {
435 uint8_t all;
436 struct
437 {
438 uint8_t invalidLlh : 1; // 1 = Invalid lon, lat, height and hMSL
439 } bits;
440 } flags3;
441 uint8_t reserved1[5];
442 int32_t headVeh; // Heading of vehicle (2-D): deg * 1e-5
443 int16_t magDec; // Magnetic declination: deg * 1e-2
444 uint16_t magAcc; // Magnetic declination accuracy: deg * 1e-2
445} UBX_NAV_PVT_data_t;
446

1251// UBX-NAV-RELPOSNED (0x01 0x3C): Relative positioning information in NED frame
1252// Note:
1253// RELPOSNED on the M8 is only 40 bytes long
1254// RELPOSNED on the F9 is 64 bytes long and contains much more information
1255const uint16_t UBX_NAV_RELPOSNED_LEN = 40;
1256const uint16_t UBX_NAV_RELPOSNED_LEN_F9 = 64;
1257
1258typedef struct
1259{
1260 uint8_t version; // Message version (0x00 for this version)
1261 uint8_t reserved0;
1262 uint16_t refStationId; // Reference Station ID
1263 uint32_t iTOW; // GPS time of week of the navigation epoch: ms
1264 int32_t relPosN; // North component of relative position vector: cm
1265 int32_t relPosE; // East component of relative position vector: cm
1266 int32_t relPosD; // Down component of relative position vector: cm
1267 int32_t relPosLength; // Length of the relative position vector: cm
1268 int32_t relPosHeading; // Heading of the relative position vector: Degrees * 1e-5
1269 uint8_t reserved1[4];
1270 int8_t relPosHPN; // High-precision North component of relative position vector: mm * 0.1
1271 int8_t relPosHPE; // High-precision East component of relative position vector: mm * 0.1
1272 int8_t relPosHPD; // High-precision Down component of relative position vector: mm * 0.1
1273 int8_t relPosHPLength; // High-precision component of the length of the relative position vector: mm * 0.1
1274 uint32_t accN; // Accuracy of relative position North component: mm * 0.1
1275 uint32_t accE; // Accuracy of relative position East component: mm * 0.1
1276 uint32_t accD; // Accuracy of relative position Down component: mm * 0.1
1277 uint32_t accLength; // Accuracy of length of the relative position vector: mm * 0.1
1278 uint32_t accHeading; // Accuracy of heading of the relative position vector: Degrees * 1e-5
1279 uint8_t reserved2[4];
1280 union
1281 {
1282 uint32_t all;
1283 struct
1284 {
1285 uint32_t gnssFixOK : 1; // A valid fix (i.e within DOP & accuracy masks)
1286 uint32_t diffSoln : 1; // 1 if differential corrections were applied
1287 uint32_t relPosValid : 1; // 1 if relative position components and accuracies are valid
1288 uint32_t carrSoln : 2; // Carrier phase range solution status:
1289 // 0 = no carrier phase range solution
1290 // 1 = carrier phase range solution with floating ambiguities
1291 // 2 = carrier phase range solution with fixed ambiguities
1292 uint32_t isMoving : 1; // 1 if the receiver is operating in moving baseline mode
1293 uint32_t refPosMiss : 1; // 1 if extrapolated reference position was used to compute moving baseline solution this epoch
1294 uint32_t refObsMiss : 1; // 1 if extrapolated reference observations were used to compute moving baseline solution this epoch
1295 uint32_t relPosHeadingValid : 1; // 1 if relPosHeading is valid
1296 uint32_t relPosNormalized : 1; // 1 if the components of the relative position vector (including the high-precision parts) are normalized
1297 } bits;
1298 } flags;
1299} UBX_NAV_RELPOSNED_data_t;

1465typedef struct
1466{

1468 uint16_t week; // GPS week number

1471 union
1472 {
1473 uint8_t all;

1475 {

1477 uint8_t clkReset : 1; // Clock reset applied
1478 } bits;

1484typedef struct
1485{

1489 uint8_t gnssId; // GNSS identifier

1494 uint8_t cno; // Carrier-to-noise density ratio: dB-Hz

1496 uint8_t cpStdev; // Estimated carrier phase measurement standard deviation: cycles * 0.004 [4-bit]

1498 union
1499 {
1500 uint8_t all;
1501 struct
1502 {

1506 uint8_t subHalfCyc : 1; // Half cycle subtracted from phase
1507 } bits;
1508 } trkStat;

1510} UBX_RXM_RAWX_block_t;

1528// UBX-RXM-COR (0x02 0x34): Differential correction input status
1529const uint16_t UBX_RXM_COR_LEN = 12;
1530
1531typedef struct
1532{
1533 uint8_t version; // Message version (0x01 for this version)
1534 uint8_t ebno; // Energy per bit to noise power spectral density ratio (Eb/N0): 2^-3 dB
1535 // 0: unknown. Reported only for protocol UBX-RXM-PMP (SPARTN) to monitor signal quality.
1536 uint8_t reserved0[2]; // Reserved
1537 union
1538 {
1539 uint32_t all;
1540 struct
1541 {
1542 uint32_t protocol : 5; // Input correction data protocol:
1543 // 0: Unknown
1544 // 1: RTCM3
1545 // 2: SPARTN (Secure Position Augmentation for Real Time Navigation)
1546 // 29: UBX-RXM-PMP (SPARTN)
1547 // 30: UBX-RXM-QZSSL6
1548 uint32_t errStatus : 2; // Error status of the received correction message content based on possibly available error codes or checksums:
1549 // 0: Unknown
1550 // 1: Error-free
1551 // 2: Erroneous
1552 uint32_t msgUsed : 2; // Status of receiver using the input message:
1553 // 0: Unknown
1554 // 1: Not used
1555 // 2: Used
1556 uint32_t correctionId : 16; // Identifier for the correction stream:
1557 // For RTCM 3: Reference station ID (DF003) of the received RTCM input message.
1558 // Valid range 0-4095.
1559 // For all other messages, reports 0xFFFF.
1560 // For other correction protocols 0xFFFF.
1561 uint32_t msgTypeValid : 1; // Validity of the msgType field. Set to False e.g. if the protocol does not define msgType.
1562 uint32_t msgSubTypeValid : 1; // Validity of the msgSubType field. Set to False e.g. if the protocol does not define subtype for the msgType.
1563 uint32_t msgInputHandle : 1; // Input handling support of the input message:
1564 // 0: Receiver does not have input handling support for this message
1565 // 1: Receiver has input handling support for this message
1566 uint32_t msgEncrypted : 2; // Encryption status of the input message:
1567 // 0: Unknown
1568 // 1: Not encrypted
1569 // 2: Encrypted
1570 uint32_t msgDecrypted : 2; // Decryption status of the input message:
1571 // 0: Unknown
1572 // 1: Not decrypted
1573 // 2: Successfully decrypted
1574 } bits;
1575 } statusInfo;
1576 uint16_t msgType; // Message type
1577 uint16_t msgSubType; // Message subtype
1578} UBX_RXM_COR_data_t;

1580// The COR data can only be accessed via a callback. COR cannot be polled.

1582{

1585 UBX_RXM_COR_data_t *callbackData;
1586} UBX_RXM_COR_t;

1588// UBX-RXM-PMP (0x02 0x72): PMP raw data (D9 modules)
1589// There are two versions of this message but, fortunately, both have a max len of 528
1590const uint16_t UBX_RXM_PMP_MAX_USER_DATA = 504;

1593typedef struct
1594{

1596 uint8_t reserved0; // Reserved
1597 uint16_t numBytesUserData; // version 0x00: reserved0 ; version 0x01: Number of bytes the userData block has in this frame (0...504)
1598 uint32_t timeTag; // Time since startup when frame started : ms
1599 uint32_t uniqueWord[2]; // Received unique words
1600 uint16_t serviceIdentifier; // Received service identifier
1601 uint8_t spare; // Received spare data
1602 uint8_t uniqueWordBitErrors; // Number of bit errors in both unique words
1603

1607 uint8_t reserved1; // Reserved
1608
1609 uint8_t userData[UBX_RXM_PMP_MAX_USER_DATA]; // Received user data: version 0x00 : starts at byte 20 ; version 0x01 : starts at byte 24
1610
1611} UBX_RXM_PMP_data_t;

1792// UBX-CFG-TP5 (0x06 0x31): Time pulse parameters

1794
1795typedef struct
1796{
1797 uint8_t tpIdx; // Time pulse selection (0 = TIMEPULSE, 1 = TIMEPULSE2)
1798 uint8_t version; // Message version (0x01 for this version)
1799 uint8_t reserved1[2];
1800 int16_t antCableDelay; // Antenna cable delay: ns
1801 int16_t rfGroupDelay; // RF group delay: ns
1802 uint32_t freqPeriod; // Frequency or period time, depending on setting of bit 'isFreq': Hz_or_us
1803 uint32_t freqPeriodLock; // Frequency or period time when locked to GNSS time, only used if 'lockedOtherSet' is set: Hz_or_us
1804 uint32_t pulseLenRatio; // Pulse length or duty cycle, depending on 'isLength': us_or_2^-32
1805 uint32_t pulseLenRatioLock; // Pulse length or duty cycle when locked to GNSS time, only used if 'lockedOtherSet' is set: us_or_2^-32
1806 int32_t userConfigDelay; // User-configurable time pulse delay: ns
1807 union
1808 {
1809 uint32_t all;
1810 struct
1811 {
1812 uint32_t active : 1; // If set enable time pulse; if pin assigned to another function, other function takes precedence.
1813 uint32_t lockGnssFreq : 1; // If set, synchronize time pulse to GNSS as soon as GNSS time is valid. If not set, or before GNSS time is valid, use local clock.
1814 uint32_t lockedOtherSet : 1; // If set the receiver switches between the timepulse settings given by 'freqPeriodLocked' & 'pulseLenLocked' and those given by 'freqPeriod' & 'pulseLen'.
1815 uint32_t isFreq : 1; // If set 'freqPeriodLock' and 'freqPeriod' are interpreted as frequency, otherwise interpreted as period.
1816 uint32_t isLength : 1; // If set 'pulseLenRatioLock' and 'pulseLenRatio' interpreted as pulse length, otherwise interpreted as duty cycle.
1817 uint32_t alignToTow : 1; // Align pulse to top of second (period time must be integer fraction of 1s). Also set 'lockGnssFreq' to use this feature.
1818 uint32_t polarity : 1; // Pulse polarity: 0: falling edge at top of second; 1: rising edge at top of second
1819 uint32_t gridUtcGnss : 4; // Timegrid to use: 0: UTC; 1: GPS; 2: GLONASS; 3: BeiDou; 4: Galileo
1820 uint32_t syncMode : 3; // Sync Manager lock mode to use:
1821 // 0: switch to 'freqPeriodLock' and 'pulseLenRatioLock' as soon as Sync Manager has an accurate time, never switch back to 'freqPeriod' and 'pulseLenRatio'
1822 // 1: switch to 'freqPeriodLock' and 'pulseLenRatioLock' as soon as Sync Manager has an accurate time, and switch back to 'freqPeriod' and 'pulseLenRatio' as soon as time gets inaccurate
1823 } bits;
1824 } flags;
1825} UBX_CFG_TP5_data_t;

1885// UBX-CFG-SMGR (0x06 0x62): Synchronization manager configuration
1886const uint16_t UBX_CFG_SMGR_LEN = 20;
1887
1888typedef struct
1889{
1890 uint8_t version; /* Message version (0x00 for this version) */
1891 uint8_t minGNSSFix; /* Minimum number of GNSS fixes before we commit to use it as a source */
1892 uint16_t maxFreqChangeRate; /* Maximum frequency change rate during disciplining. Must not exceed 30ppb/s*/
1893 uint16_t maxPhaseCorrRate; /* Maximum phase correction rate in coherent time pulse mode. */
1894 uint8_t reserved1[2]; /* Reserved. Do not use */
1895 uint16_t freqTolerance; /* Freq limit of possible deviation from nominal */
1896 uint16_t timeTolerance; /* Time pulse limit of possible deviation from nominal */
1897 union {
1898 uint16_t all;
1899 struct {
1900 uint16_t measInternal : 1; /* 1 = report the estimated offset of the internal oscillator based on the oscillator model */
1901 uint16_t measGNSS : 1; /* 1 = report the internal oscillator's offset relative to GNSS */
1902 uint16_t measEXTINT0 : 1; /* 1 = report the internal oscillator's offset relative to the source on EXTINT0 */
1903 uint16_t measEXTINT1 : 1; /* 1 = report the internal oscillator's offset relative to the source on EXTINT1 */
1904 } bits;
1905 } messageCfg;
1906 uint16_t maxSlewRate;
1907 union {
1908 uint32_t all;
1909 struct {
1910 uint32_t disableInternal : 1; /* 1 = disable disciplining of the internal oscillator */
1911 uint32_t disableExternal : 1; /* 1 = disable disciplining of the external oscillator */
1912 uint32_t preferenceMode : 1; /* Reference selection preference: 0 - best frequency accuracy; 1 - best phase accuracy */
1913 uint32_t enableGNSS : 1; /* 1 = enable use of GNSS as synchronization source */
1914 uint32_t enableEXTINT0 : 1; /* 1 = enable use of EXTINT0 as synchronization source */
1915 uint32_t enableEXTINT1 : 1; /* 1 = enable use of EXTINT1 as synchronization source */
1916 uint32_t enableHostMeasInt : 1; /* 1 = enable use of host measurements on the internal oscillator as synchronization source */
1917 uint32_t enableHostMeasExt : 1; /* 1 = enable use of host measurements on the external oscillator as synchronization source */
1918 uint32_t reserved : 2; /* Reserved. Do not use */
1919 uint32_t useAnyFix : 1; /* 0 - use over-determined navigation solutions only; 1 - use any fix */
1920 uint32_t disableMaxSlewRate : 1; /* 1 - don't use the value in the field maxSlewRate */
1921 uint32_t issueFreqWarn : 1; /* 1 - issue a warning (via UBX-TIM-TOS flag) when frequency uncertainty exceeds freqTolerance */
1922 uint32_t issueTimeWarn : 1; /* 1 = issue a warning (via UBX-TIM-TOS flag) when time uncertainty exceeds timeTolerance */
1923 uint32_t TPCoherent : 2; /* Control time pulse coherency: 0 - Coherent pulses; 1 - Non-coherent pulses; 2 - Post-initialization coherent pulses*/
1924 uint32_t disableOffset : 1; /* 1 = disable automatic storage of oscillator offset */
1925 } bits;
1926 } flags;
1927} UBX_CFG_SMGR_data_t;

2292
2293 uint32_t iTOW : 1;

2296 uint32_t zAngRate : 1;
2297 uint32_t xAccel : 1;
2298 uint32_t yAccel : 1;
2299 uint32_t zAccel : 1;
2300 } bits;
2301 } moduleQueried;
2302} UBX_ESF_INS_moduleQueried_t;

2304typedef struct

2314// UBX-ESF-MEAS (0x10 0x02): External sensor fusion measurements
2315// Note: length is variable
2316// Note: ESF RAW data cannot be polled. It is "Output" only
2317const uint16_t UBX_ESF_MEAS_MAX_LEN = 8 + (4 * DEF_MAX_NUM_ESF_MEAS) + 4;
2318
2319typedef struct
2320{
2321 union
2322 {
2323 uint32_t all;
2324 struct
2325 {
2326 uint32_t dataField : 24; // Data
2327 uint32_t dataType : 6; // Type of data (0 = no data; 1..63 = data type)
2328 } bits;
2329 } data;
2330} UBX_ESF_MEAS_sensorData_t;
2331
2332typedef struct
2333{
2334 uint32_t timeTag; // Time tag of measurement generated by external sensor
2335 union
2336 {
2337 uint16_t all;
2338 struct
2339 {
2340 uint16_t timeMarkSent : 2; // Time mark signal was supplied just prior to sending this message:
2341 // 0 = none, 1 = on Ext0, 2 = on Ext1
2342 uint16_t timeMarkEdge : 1; // Trigger on rising (0) or falling (1) edge of time mark signal
2343 uint16_t calibTtagValid : 1; // Calibration time tag available. Always set to zero.
2344 uint16_t reserved : 7;
2345 uint16_t numMeas : 5; // Number of measurements contained in this message (optional, can be obtained from message size)
2346 } bits;
2347 } flags;
2348 uint16_t id; // Identification number of data provider
2349 UBX_ESF_MEAS_sensorData_t data[DEF_MAX_NUM_ESF_MEAS];
2350 uint32_t calibTtag; // OPTIONAL: Receiver local time calibrated: ms
2351} UBX_ESF_MEAS_data_t;
2352
2353typedef struct
2354{
2355 ubxAutomaticFlags automaticFlags;

2362// UBX-ESF-RAW (0x10 0x03): Raw sensor measurements

2366// Note: ESF RAW data cannot be polled. It is "Output" only
2367const uint16_t UBX_ESF_RAW_MAX_LEN = 4 + (8 * DEF_NUM_SENS * DEF_MAX_NUM_ESF_RAW_REPEATS);
2368
2369typedef struct
2370{
2371 union
2372 {
2373 uint32_t all;
2374 struct
2375 {

2378 } bits;
2379 } data;
2380 uint32_t sTag; // Sensor time tag
2381} UBX_ESF_RAW_sensorData_t;
2382
2383typedef struct
2384{
2385 uint8_t reserved1[4];

2390typedef struct
2391{
2392 ubxAutomaticFlags automaticFlags;

2397} UBX_ESF_RAW_t;

2399// UBX-ESF-STATUS (0x10 0x10): External sensor fusion status
2400// Note: length is variable
2401const uint16_t UBX_ESF_STATUS_MAX_LEN = 16 + (4 * DEF_NUM_SENS);
2402
2403typedef struct
2404{
2405 union
2406 {
2407 uint8_t all;
2408 struct
2409 {
2410 uint8_t type : 6; // Sensor data type
2411 uint8_t used : 1; // If set, sensor data is used for the current sensor fusion solution
2412 uint8_t ready : 1; // If set, sensor is set up (configuration is available or not required) but not used for computing the current sensor fusion solution.
2413 } bits;
2414 } sensStatus1;
2415 union
2416 {
2417 uint8_t all;
2418 struct
2419 {
2420 uint8_t calibStatus : 2; // 00: Sensor is not calibrated
2421 // 01: Sensor is calibrating
2422 // 10/11: Sensor is calibrated
2423 uint8_t timeStatus : 2; // 00: No data
2424 // 01: Reception of the first byte used to tag the measurement
2425 // 10: Event input used to tag the measurement
2426 // 11: Time tag provided with the data
2427 } bits;
2428 } sensStatus2;
2429 uint8_t freq; // Observation frequency: Hz
2430 union
2431 {
2432 uint8_t all;
2433 struct
2434 {
2435 uint8_t badMeas : 1; // Bad measurements detected
2436 uint8_t badTTag : 1; // Bad measurement time-tags detected
2437 uint8_t missingMeas : 1; // Missing or time-misaligned measurements detected
2438 uint8_t noisyMeas : 1; // High measurement noise-level detected
2439 } bits;
2440 } faults;
2441} UBX_ESF_STATUS_sensorStatus_t;
2442
2443typedef struct
2444{

2446 uint8_t version; // Message version (0x02 for this version)
2447 uint8_t reserved1[7];
2448 uint8_t fusionMode; // Fusion mode:
2449 // 0: Initialization mode: receiver is initializing some unknown values required for doing sensor fusion
2450 // 1: Fusion mode: GNSS and sensor data are used for navigation solution computation
2451 // 2: Suspended fusion mode: sensor fusion is temporarily disabled due to e.g. invalid sensor data or detected ferry
2452 // 3: Disabled fusion mode: sensor fusion is permanently disabled until receiver reset due e.g. to sensor error
2453 uint8_t reserved2[2];
2454 uint8_t numSens; // Number of sensors
2455 UBX_ESF_STATUS_sensorStatus_t status[DEF_NUM_SENS];
2456} UBX_ESF_STATUS_data_t;

2459{

2461 {

2464 {

2468 uint32_t version : 1;
2469 uint32_t fusionMode : 1;
2470 uint32_t numSens : 1;
2471
2472 uint32_t status : DEF_NUM_SENS;
2473 } bits;
2474 } moduleQueried;
2475} UBX_ESF_STATUS_moduleQueried_t;

2487// MGA-specific structs

2489// UBX-MGA-ACK-DATA0 (0x13 0x60): Multiple GNSS acknowledge message
2490const uint16_t UBX_MGA_ACK_DATA0_LEN = 8;
2491
2492typedef struct
2493{
2494 uint8_t type; // Type of acknowledgment:
2495 // 0: The message was not used by the receiver (see infoCode field for an indication of why)
2496 // 1: The message was accepted for use by the receiver (the infoCode field will be 0)
2497 uint8_t version; // Message version

2499 // See sfe_ublox_mga_ack_infocode_e
2500 uint8_t msgId; // UBX message ID of the acknowledged message
2501 uint8_t msgPayloadStart[4]; // The first 4 bytes of the acknowledged message's payload

2504#define UBX_MGA_ACK_DATA0_RINGBUFFER_LEN 16 // Provide storage for 16 MGA ACK packets

2506{
2507 uint8_t head;
2508 uint8_t tail;

2510} UBX_MGA_ACK_DATA0_t;

2512// UBX-MGA-DBD (0x13 0x80): Navigation database dump entry
2513const uint16_t UBX_MGA_DBD_LEN = 164; // "The maximum payload size for firmware 2.01 onwards is 164 bytes"
2514
2515typedef struct
2516{

2520 uint8_t dbdEntryID;

2531#define UBX_MGA_DBD_RINGBUFFER_LEN 250 // Provide storage for MGA DBD packets. TO DO: confirm if 250 is large enough for all modules!
2532#endif

2534typedef struct
2535{
2536 uint8_t head;
2537 uint8_t tail;
2538 UBX_MGA_DBD_data_t data[UBX_MGA_DBD_RINGBUFFER_LEN]; // Create a storage array for the MGA DBD packets
2539} UBX_MGA_DBD_t;

2546typedef struct
2547{

2556 {

2559 {

2563 } bits;

2569 // 0x02 = 2D-Fix
2570 // 0x03 = 3D-Fix
2571 // 0x04 = GPS + dead reckoning combined

2575 {
2576 uint8_t all;
2577 struct
2578 {

2588 int32_t lat; // Latitude: Degrees * 1e-7
2589 int32_t height; // Height above ellipsoid: mm
2590 int32_t hMSL; // Height above MSL: mm
2591 int32_t gSpeed; // Ground Speed (2-D): mm/s
2592 int32_t speed; // Speed (3-D): mm/s
2593 int32_t headMot; // Heading of motion (2-D): Degrees * 1e-5
2594 int32_t headVeh; // Heading of vehicle (2-D): Degrees * 1e-5
2595 uint32_t hAcc; // Horizontal accuracy: mm
2596 uint32_t vAcc; // Vertical accuracy: mm
2597 uint32_t sAcc; // Speed accuracy: mm/s
2598 uint32_t headAcc; // Heading accuracy: Degrees * 1e-5
2599 uint8_t reserved2[4];
2600} UBX_HNR_PVT_data_t;

2637 uint32_t speed : 1;

2639 uint32_t headVeh : 1;
2640 uint32_t hAcc : 1;
2641 uint32_t vAcc : 1;

2776{

2778 {
2779 uint8_t all;

2781 {

2785 } bits;
